item.title: Westmoreland burn victim, Dacia Forrester succumbs
item.description: The Westmoreland woman who was doused in gasoline and set on fire during an altercation at a service station in Whithorn last month has died. 40-year-old Dacia Forrester succumbed sometime between last night and this morning. item.title: Investigation underway to determine cause of JUTC bus fire
item.description: A multi-agency investigation is underway to determine the cause of a fire which engulfed a Jamaica Urban Transit Company (JUTC ) bus in Kingston this morning. item.title: Jolyan Silvera sentenced to 20 years and 10 months in prison, Melissa Silvera’s relatives satisfied with time given
item.description: Mr. Silvera was sentenced in the Supreme Court today by Chief Justice Bryan Sykes.
